poolEntry.name: PeoplePulse
poolEntry.investors: Founders and friends-and-family; Women in Tech Accelerator Nigeria Cycle 7 top 11 finalist
poolEntry.notes: Founded June 2025; piloted May-Jul 2026 with ~280 employees across 8 companies, all 8 converted into paying SME customers at NGN 2,000-3,500/employee/month.
